config.eligibility: event must have data/filtered/{ticker}_{date}_{momentum_pct:.2f}/ with both trades.parquet and quotes.parquet

t5c_rebuild_check.method: reran research/phase_0b/build_dev_sample.py in a fresh process, compared SHA256 of config/dev_sample_events.csv before and after

t5d_representative_query.description: per-event trade count + minute-bucketed volume across all 50 dev events
t5d_representative_query.sql: SELECT ticker, event_date, COUNT(*) AS n_trades, date_trunc('minute', to_timestamp(sip_timestamp/1e9)) AS minute_bucket, SUM(size) AS volume FROM filtered_trades_dev GROUP BY ticker, event_date, minute_bucket ORDER BY ticker, event_date, minute_bucket
